# Time Tracker

> A free time tracker and invoicing tool for freelancers, built in Vietnam and
> bilingual in Vietnamese and English. One key starts a per-project timer and the
> money accrues by the second; at the end of a period the uninvoiced hours become
> a PDF invoice with VAT and an auto-incrementing number. Local-first, so it keeps
> working with no connection and syncs when the connection returns.

Vietnamese: Ứng dụng bấm giờ và xuất hoá đơn miễn phí cho freelancer. Bấm một
phím là đồng hồ chạy và tiền cộng dồn theo từng giây; gộp giờ chưa xuất thành hoá
đơn PDF có VAT. Chạy offline, đồng bộ lại khi có mạng.

- Marketing site: https://timetracker.io.vn (Vietnamese) · https://timetracker.io.vn/en (English)
- The app itself: https://app.timetracker.io.vn — requires sign-in, so it is not crawlable
- Contact: hello@timetracker.io.vn

## What it costs

Free. No card, no trial, no paid tier. No cap on projects, time entries or
invoices. There is no team or enterprise plan — the product is scoped to one
freelancer working alone, and has no team management or payroll features.

## What it does

- **Time tracking.** A per-project timer with a live money counter. Manual
  entries, editing, tags, and a non-billable flag. Pomodoro timer, idle
  detection, cross-tab sync, and a command palette. Keyboard: `S` start/stop,
  `N` manual entry, `Cmd+K` palette, `D` light/dark.
- **Invoicing.** Pick a project and a period; the app gathers every uninvoiced
  entry, applies the configured rounding, adds VAT, assigns an auto-incrementing
  number, and prints or saves a PDF. The print view stays on white paper.
- **Rounding.** Up or to nearest, in steps of 5, 6, 10, 15 or 30 minutes. Reports
  show actual hours next to billable hours so the effect is visible before
  committing.
- **Currencies.** VND, USD, EUR and SGD. Rate and currency are set per project,
  and reports total each currency separately rather than converting between them.
- **Reports.** By project, by day, or line by line as it will appear on the
  invoice. Exportable as CSV.
- **Dashboard.** Hours today and this week against a goal, a streak of working
  days, and uninvoiced hours broken out by currency.
- **Offline and sync.** Local-first: actions are written to the device first, so
  tracking continues with no network and changes upload when it returns.
- **Install.** A PWA — installable to the iOS or Android Home Screen, or to a
  desktop Dock, running full screen with no address bar.
- **Languages.** Vietnamese and English, switchable in the app. Invoices print in
  whichever language is selected.

## Accounts and data

- Sign-in is Google SSO or an emailed magic link. There is no password.
- Data is held twice: once on the device so the app works offline, and once in
  Supabase Postgres tied to the signed-in account.
- Export is unrestricted — CSV from the time log and reports, or the whole
  dataset as a single JSON backup from Settings.
- Privacy policy: https://timetracker.io.vn/privacy
- Terms: https://timetracker.io.vn/terms

## How it compares

Smaller in scope than Toggl, Clockify or Harvest, and aimed at a different
reader: the Vietnamese-language interface, VND rates and printable VAT invoices
are built in rather than adapted. It has no team management, no payroll, no
approval flows and no client portal. If the requirement is tracking a team, this
is the wrong tool.
